title: Test suite runtime comparison
method: Monotonic perf_counter around subprocesses. No investigation workloads ran concurrently with timed samples. Shared developer laptop, not an isolated benchmark host. Baseline measurements preceded candidate measurements and are not randomized paired observations.

rust.scope: Warm complete cargo test command, including cached-build check, all default test targets, doctests, and process startup/exit. Excludes clippy and rustfmt.

validation.note: One exhaustive attack-map test is partitioned into four disjoint groups. All piece types, colors, promotion flags, board origins, and target squares remain covered. All other tests retain their names and status.

rust.warmup_build_note: The candidate was built and tested by cargo fmt && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test before these samples. Recompilation is excluded; no cold-build or whole-CI speedup is inferred.

deploy.scope: Baseline measures unittest discovery plus test execution; candidate measures the complete parallel-runner process including startup/exit. The baseline excludes a small interpreter startup/exit overhead. Both use the full allowed CPU set. Baseline deployment source is identical at a734502.
deploy.notes: The two fixed supervisor waits are controlled by fixture barriers; production wait durations are unchanged. Parallel stress exposed an existing PID-file publication race, fixed by atomic fixture writes.

nnue.baseline_command: taskset -c 0-3 <Python 3.12.14 with pinned CPU dependencies> <serial unittest module runner>
nnue.scope: Complete serial and parallel processes including discovery/imports, startup, and exit. Both variants have CPUs 0-3 available; the candidate partitions these four logical CPUs across four processes.
nnue.notes: The complete discovered ID set is checked by the runner and was also compared against the baseline profile in all three candidate samples. No NNUE test bodies changed.

cache.scope: CI installed NNUE virtual environment, keyed by runner OS/architecture, exact Python version, and requirements hash.
cache.note: This verifies requirements in an already installed local environment. It does not measure GitHub cache download/extraction or claim a CI setup speedup. First use and changed keys install the pinned dependencies normally; cache hits retain existing transitive dependency versions.

limits: Small sample counts: report min/max and sample standard deviation only; no latency percentiles or confidence intervals.
Rust data measured a31be0d; the Rust/Cargo source is identical at the final implementation revision.
Deployment has one baseline observation, so its baseline variability is unknown. Its baseline timing boundary is slightly narrower than the candidate.
Local runtime reductions cannot be multiplied directly into CI job durations, which include build/setup and different hardware/toolchains.
The full-suite serial deployment command also passed after implementation; randomized-search and tactical-tree Python suites passed.
Whole-tree Ruff sees pre-existing untracked analysis scripts with lint failures. All 158 tracked Python files pass format and lint checks.
